checks.title: 同一房间同一晚出现两条房晚记录（超售）
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ( SELECT room_id, stay_date FROM room_nights GROUP BY room_id, stay_date HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicates

checks.title: 同一房间存在时间段重叠的有效订单
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM bookings a JOIN bookings b ON a.room_id = b.room_id AND a.id < b.id WHERE a.status IN ('confirmed', 'checked_in') AND b.status IN ('confirmed', 'checked_in') AND a.check_in < b.check_out AND b.check_in < a.check_out

checks.title: 有效订单的房晚数与住宿天数不一致
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ( SELECT b.id FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN room_nights rn ON rn.booking_id = b.id WHERE b.status IN ('confirmed', 'checked_in') GROUP BY b.id, b.check_in, b.check_out HAVING COUNT(rn.id) <> DATEDIFF(b.check_out, b.check_in) ) mismatched

checks.title: 房晚落在订单入住区间之外
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM room_nights rn JOIN bookings b ON rn.booking_id = b.id WHERE rn.stay_date < b.check_in OR rn.stay_date >= b.check_out

checks.title: 已取消/未到店订单仍占用房晚
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM room_nights rn JOIN bookings b ON rn.booking_id = b.id WHERE b.status NOT IN ('confirmed', 'checked_in')

checks.title: 有效订单的逐晚金额合计与订单总额不一致
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ( SELECT b.id FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN booking_price_lines pl ON pl.booking_id = b.id WHERE b.status IN ('confirmed', 'checked_in') GROUP BY b.id, b.check_in, b.check_out, b.total HAVING COUNT(pl.id) <> DATEDIFF(b.check_out, b.check_in) OR COALESCE(SUM(pl.amount), 0) <> b.total ) mismatched

checks.title: 压测创建的订单落在维修封锁区间内
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM room_nights rn JOIN bookings b ON b.id = rn.booking_id JOIN users u ON u.id = b.actor_user_id JOIN room_blocks rb ON rb.room_id = rn.room_id AND rb.effective = 1 WHERE rn.stay_date >= rb.start_date AND rn.stay_date < rb.end_date AND u.email LIKE '%@load.test'

checks.title: 同一操作人同一幂等键产生多张订单
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ( SELECT actor_user_id, idempotency_key FROM bookings GROUP BY actor_user_id, idempotency_key HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicates

checks.title: 订单总额为负，或逐晚金额为负
checks.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE total < 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking_price_lines WHERE amount < 0) AS n

checks.title: 订单的房晚房间与订单房型不一致
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM room_nights rn JOIN bookings b ON b.id = rn.booking_id JOIN rooms r ON r.id = rn.room_id WHERE r.room_type_id <> b.room_type_id

checks.title: 房晚落在房间停用期内
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM room_nights rn JOIN rooms r ON r.id = rn.room_id WHERE rn.stay_date < r.operational_from OR (r.operational_until IS NOT NULL AND rn.stay_date >= r.operational_until)

checks.title: 孤儿房晚（订单或房间已不存在）
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM room_nights rn LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.id = rn.booking_id LEFT JOIN rooms r ON r.id = rn.room_id WHERE b.id IS NULL OR r.id IS NULL

checks.title: 同名房型重复（演示数据会产生重复筛选行）
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM ( SELECT name FROM room_types GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) duplicates
